note: Limited ground calibration on a held-out date or campaign, with spatially independent checks. For each group (a held-out Gaocheng date or a Knezha campaign) the plots are split into a sampling pool and an evaluation set. Two splits are used: random_half a random half of the plots forms the pool (as in script 36); spatial_half a random half of the 40 m blocks (Gaocheng) or fields (Knezha) forms the pool; Gaocheng evaluation plots within 10 m of a pool plot are dropped. k plots are chosen from the pool by one of six strategies and their labels feed one of six estimators, all of the form y_hat = ybar_S + lambda (f - fbar_S): label_mean lambda = 0 weighted_mean lambda = 0, cluster means weighted by the share of plots in each cluster offset lambda = 1 asrc_prior lambda = lambda0 asrc lambda = clip((S_fy + m v_f lambda0) / (S_ff + m v_f), 0, 1) ridge_affine lambda = S_fy / (S_ff + m v_f) S_fy and S_ff are the centred cross- and sum of squares of the k labels and predictions, v_f is the prediction variance over all plots of the group (no labels) and m = 5 is fixed in advance. lambda0 is the within-date slope of the observed on the predicted values in data the model did not train on and that are not from the evaluated group: Gaocheng calibration rows of the training dates of the same leave-one-date-out fold, and for Knezha the Gaocheng out-of-fold predictions of the same four-band model. No estimator uses evaluation labels. Monte Carlo bands describe split and selection randomness only; spread across groups is reported separately. Run after 35 and 42.
